negative_snippets: Worst hotel experience of my life and I'm an avid traveler. Any positive reviews are definitely fabricated cause you can feel that something's not quite right the moment you enter the hotel. Especially as a solo female traveler. Old rooms, flies buzzing around, urine smelling and dirty bathroom akin to a public toilet with a moldy bucket to wash, no hot water and a bed that felt old, including the bedsheets. Barely slept and checked into a new hotel despite the manager promising me a new room. After one bad night, I was definitely not willing to sacrifice another to this hotel, during my trip. Also, obscure location that can be easily missed as you have to almost drive into the parking garage first to get to the entrance. Do not recommend to anyone!
